arguments.description: Validate normalized JSON contract and confirm inputs intact

event.content:
Command 'cd "<WORKSPACE>" && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, glob
allowed = {
 "customer": {"record_id","record_type","name","email","status","source_path"},
 "order":    {"record_id","record_type","customer_id","amount","currency","status","source_path"},
 "note":     {"record_id","record_type","owner","status","source_path"},
}
seen=set(); errs=[]
for p in sorted(glob.glob("normalized/*.json")):
    d=json.load(open(p))
    rt=d["record_type"]
    if set(d.keys())!=allowed[rt]:
        errs.append(f"{p}: keys {set(d.keys())^allowed[rt]}")
    if rt=="order":
        if not isinstance(d["amount"],(int,float)) or isinstance(d["amount"],bool): errs.append(f"{p}: amount not number")
        if d["status"]!="active": errs.append(f"{p}: order status not active")
    rid=d["record_id"]
    if rid in seen: errs.append(f"{p}: dup id {rid}")
    seen.add(rid)
print("records:",len(seen))
print("contract errors:", errs if errs else "NONE")
PY
